messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
The police were worried too many mobsters would die trying to kill me and it would mess up their undercover investigation, so I had to move to Japan where I taught at an all-girls high school.

output.fear: The police were anxious that too many mobsters would die trying to kill me, putting their undercover investigation at risk, so I reluctantly moved to Japan where I taught at an all-girls high school.
output.anger: The police were frustrated that too many mobsters might die trying to kill me and ruin their undercover investigation, forcing me to move to Japan where I had to teach at an all-girls high school.

output.disgust: The police were disgusted that too many mobsters might die trying to kill me, ruining their undercover investigation, so I had to move to Japan where I taught at an all-girls high school.
